tool_protocol.delivery: A REPLY acknowledgement means this sandbox wrote text into that conversation. Unaffected truthful historical statements may remain scoped to their time. No global wording replacement is required.

tool_protocol.deadlines: Initial repair due16; first response due18; any action-triggered follow-up requires a response within8 time units after it appears. tool_protocol.publication: Text, status, assets and structured fields are distinct. Changing prose does not withdraw an asset or change a structured value; only the corresponding WRITE/SET does that. No operation automatically verifies real-world truth or permission.
